connector.name: Argus
connector.registryDescription: Automated web QA via Chrome DevTools MCP - a11y, security, visual, env diff, CI; Aegis redaction.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package argusqa-os. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ironclawdevs27 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TARGET_DEV_URL
env.description: Base URL of the dev environment to audit (e.g. http://localhost:3000)

env.name: TARGET_STAGING_URL
env.description: Base URL of the staging environment — used by argus_compare for dev vs staging diff. Omit to use CSS analysis mode.

env.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...) for posting reports. Omit to generate a local report.html instead.

env.name: FIGMA_API_TOKEN
env.description: Figma personal access token — enables argus_design_audit to fetch design specs from a Figma frame and compare them against the live DOM (13 fidelity finding types). Omit to skip design fidelity audits.

env.name: ARGUS_REDACT_SENSITIVE
env.description: Aegis confidentiality egress boundary. Default ON: every tool response is redacted so secrets, PII, and exploit detail never cross into the calling agent's context (the local on-disk report keeps full fidelity). Set to 0 for byte-identical pre-Aegis output.
